articles.author: Connect Biopharma Holdings Ltd
articles.headline: Connect Biopharma Announces Positive Preliminary Topline Data from its Global Phase 2 Study of Rademikibart as an Add-on Treatment for Acute Exacerbations in Adults with COPD and Type 2 Inflammation
articles.summary: Connect reports preliminary Phase 2 COPD data in 159 participants, including an 81% reduction in treatment failure through four weeks (p=0.0122). The reported 70 mL FEV1 difference was not statistically significant (p=0.1607). Planned FDA discussions and Phase 3 development do not constitute marketing approval.
